rows.en: Oswald: "..."
???: "...I'm disappointed.
I never imagined you would be this useless..."
Oswald: "..."
???: "...A pendant like this..."
Oswald: "...That's not..."
Oswald: "That... wasn't the deal..."
???: "And here I wondered what you were going to say...
The deal? I said that if you brought me the queen's crystal,
I would hand the queen herself over to you.
You're the one who went and killed her..."
Oswald: "No!!
I... I never meant to kill her...
But at that moment, someone else entered my mind!
It was you! You did it to me... with that cursed 'Evil Eye'!"
???: "Heh... No, that's not true.
That was you yourself. Something sleeping deep within your heart.
All I did was wake it up for you."
Oswald: "Y-you bastard..."
???: "Oops. Don't come any closer.
I'm in a very bad mood right now.
Even if I only accepted this job as a favor,
my pride won't allow me to fail..."
Oswald: "K... Kieeeeeeeeeh!!"
Oswald: "What?! You dodged it?!"
Oswald: "Eek..."
???: "Tch. He fell...
There's a river at the bottom of the gorge... I doubt he's alive, but...
Well... Even if he is, it won't make any difference..."
Fain: "Wh-what do you mean?!"
Celica: "As! I! Said!
It's because you keep doing reckless things!
That's why Mireon breaks down!
Your Prana is too high to begin with.
Learn to control it a little better!"
Touya: "Huh. Wouldn't that mean you could
pilot a Spirit Mech too?"
Fain: "!!"
Ymir: "Well... We don't have a machine for you right now, but...
If we go to the Holy Land..."
Fain: "Y-Ymir, i-is that true?!
I-I could pilot a Spirit Mech?!"
Ymir: "Y-yes... Perhaps it wouldn't hurt
to give it a try..."
Celica: "...But I doubt the Kingdom of Agarthia
will give you permission.
You are an Agarthian knight, after all."
Fain: "N-no..."
Touya: "What the hell?! An enemy attack?!"
Celica: "It doesn't look like it, but..."
Gabon: "Engine room here.
We've got a bit of a problem."
Ymir: "What's wrong?"
Gabon: "The engine's output won't stabilize.
At this rate, it won't last until we reach the Holy Land."
Celica: "Maybe it's because we put it straight into service without breaking it in?
We'll have to check it over first."
Gabon: "Well, that's all we can do."
Ymir: "Then... let's land on the shore of that lake."
Gabon: "That'll help."
Ymir: "We'll wait here until the checks are finished."
Clovis: "Then Arthur and I will take a quick look
around the area. That all right?"
Ymir: "Hm? Oh, yes. An attack now would be
dangerous... Could I ask you to do that, then?
But please don't do anything too conspicuous."
Arthur: "We understand.
I'll make sure to keep a close eye on him."
Clovis: "Hey, hey! You mean me?"
Arthur: "There aren't any towns or even villages nearby,
so you won't be able to pick up girls."
Clovis: "Urk..."
Celica: "What does 'pick up girls' mean?"
Ymir: "Apparently, it's when a man tries to charm a woman."
Celica: "Hmm. Wait... But how come
you know about that, Ymir?"
Ymir: "Huh?! Ah, ha ha ha ha... Well, you know..."
Touya: "...Hey, what should I do?"
Ymir: "Hm?"
Touya: "Everyone else is working. I can't be
the only one sitting around doing nothing, can I?"
Fain: "Indeed. That's the spirit."
Ymir: "Please don't feel you have to do that.
You haven't been in this world for very long, Touya.
You should rest while you have the chance."
Touya: "But..."
Yamato: "She's offering, so let's take her up on it."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "...? What's wrong?"
Touya: "It's nothing..."
Celica: "Ohhh... Don't tell me you get lonely by yourself?"
Touya: "...Maybe I do."
Celica: "Huh...? I was joking, but... What's wrong?"
Touya: "I've got a lot on my mind, you know.
Sure, I didn't refuse, but I keep finding myself fighting...
Things I'd never even imagined before are part of everyday life now."
Yamato: "Touya..."
Ymir: "...I'm sorry... Of course.
We've been taking advantage of your kindness...
If you really don't want to fight..."
Touya: "...Oh, I put that badly, didn't I?
That's not what I meant.
I just haven't come to terms with it myself...
So I want to understand what's going on around me a little better,
and then make up my mind.
As I get a feel for the situation I'm in..."
Celica: "In other words, right now you want to act instead of just thinking.
And you want to try different things
to find out whether what you're doing is right... Is that it?"
Touya: "It's nothing that grand,
but I figure it's better than just sitting around thinking."
Ymir: "I see... In that case..."
Celica: "...You should rest after all."
Ymir: "Huh...?"
Celica: "Throwing yourself into something is fine,
but there's nothing wrong with taking your time to look around once in a while.
Being impatient won't get you anywhere."
Yamato: "That's right. We should take her up on her offer while we can."
Touya: "...Yeah... You're right..."
Celica: "Oh, right. Ai said she was going to make something in the kitchen.
Why don't you drop by?
She might give you something tasty to eat."
Touya: "...That sounds a little scary, actually."
Celica: "Hee hee."
Ymir: "Celica, it's about time..."
Celica: "Oh, right. Well, we're going
to the engine room. Remember, take it easy, okay?"
Touya: "Y-yeah..."
Yamato: "...Well then, we should... Oh,
could we go back to our room first?"
Touya: "Huh? I don't mind, but..."
Yamato: "Somehow, if I don't go back there at least once,
I just can't feel nyormal."
Touya: "..."

review_batches.context: Examined all 137 s_006 rows, all 178 s_007 rows, s_005 rows 118..129 and s_008 rows 0..79 (407 total). Oswald confronts an unidentified accomplice about the wrong pendant and Alforina's death. After that scene, Fain's high Prana damages Mireon; engine problems force a lakeside stop and the crew discusses patrols.
review_batches.decisions: Keep ??? concealed and preserve both conflicting accounts of Oswald's responsibility: he claims mind intrusion; the other speaker claims only to have awakened his own buried feelings. Evil Eye is an editorial ability name, not proof of the accusation. Do not confirm Oswald dead after the fall. Fain's possible Spirit Mech use remains conditional on machine availability and permission. Mireon and the other glossary names remain exact. Arthur's watch-over joke is aimed at Clovis, confirmed by the next replies about picking up girls.

row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o000ae.l00: Deliberate contemptuous fragment about the pendant; do not replace it with the crystal he expected.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o000dc.l00: Oswald's denial is unfinished, clarified by his next statement about the deal.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00129.l01: The deal was the queen's crystal in exchange for custody of the queen, not a promise that she would be killed.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o001d4.l01: Oswald explicitly denies an intention to kill her; this remains his account, not independent narration.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o001d4.l03: Keep the accusation and quoted Evil Eye ability; do not identify the concealed speaker.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00245.l01: The unidentified speaker attributes the act to Oswald's own buried self, contradicting his excuse. Preserve the dispute. The second sentence is a deliberate appositive fragment identifying that self.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00296.l00: Deliberate angry, trailing insult; do not soften it into a polite address.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o002b0.p01.l00: Same speech continues across FE; the job was accepted as a favor/obligation, with no named client added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00325.l00: Deliberate attack cry and stammer rather than lexical prose.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00453.l01: Survival is doubted by the speaker, not disproved by the narrator. The following script explicitly has Oswald alive.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00533.l00: Celica's syllable-by-syllable insistence becomes emphatically separated English words.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o005e5.l01: Ymir's possible Holy Land solution deliberately trails off; no guaranteed assignment of a Spirit Mech is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00654.l00: Ymir's tentative recommendation continues into row 46.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00683.l00: Celica's permission warning continues into row 48, explicitly tied to Fain's national knight status.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00733.l00: Celica's tentative denial of an attack trails off before the engine-room report.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o0078c.l01: The engine will not last to the Holy Land at this rate; do not turn this into a stated fuel shortage.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o007be.l00: Celica speculates about putting the engine into service without a break-in period; she has not diagnosed the cause.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00918.l00: Clovis's proposal spans rows 64..65 and includes Arthur, not Touya.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00951.l01: Ymir asks the two men to patrol; keep the direction of the request explicit.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o009a9.l01: Arthur's him is Clovis, confirmed by Clovis's reply and the following joke.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00a37.l00: Celica asks about the same Earth phrase used by Arthur, preserving the joke without teaching an unrelated concept.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00aaa.l00: Ymir deliberately evades explaining how she knows; keep her embarrassed unfinished reply.

review_batches.context: Examined all 137 s_006 rows, all 178 s_007 rows, s_005 rows 118..129 and s_008 rows 0..79. Touya wants to help while others work. Celica's loneliness joke unexpectedly opens a serious conversation about his unease over fighting, after which they urge him to rest and visit Ai in the kitchen.
review_batches.decisions: Touya does not revoke his willingness to help, and he does not claim he was forced to fight. Preserve his distinction between not refusing and not yet having come to terms with the situation. Ymir acknowledges relying on his kindness. Celica recommends rest rather than treating action as the answer. Keep Yamato's request to return to their room unexplained; do not invent what she needs to do there. Catlike speech uses selected ny spellings.

row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00b21.l00: Touya's question spans both rows and asserts that he should also help, not that others should stop working.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00c56.l00: Deliberately evasive reply, not a new claim of being physically unwell.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00cab.l00: Touya unexpectedly acknowledges possible loneliness instead of taking the joke lightly.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00d03.l02: Fighting is now part of daily life despite having been unimaginable before; preserve his disorientation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00d87.l01: Ymir admits reliance on his kindness; the thought deliberately trails off.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00d87.l02: Conditional offer deliberately trails off when Touya clarifies his meaning.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00dda.l02: Touya has not internally accepted/understood the situation; do not recast this as a refusal to help.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00dda.l05: Deliberate trailing qualification of his plan, with the first-person subject restored in English.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00ef8.l00: Ymir's proposed next step is deliberately interrupted by Celica's rest recommendation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o00f63.l00: Concessive clause continues into the following advice.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o0108a.l00: Ymir's time reminder is deliberately unfinished; Celica supplies their engine-room destination.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o01114.l00: Yamato starts to propose their own next action, then interrupts herself to ask to return to their room.
row_decisions.scenario.s_006.o0116c.l00: Conditional thought continues into row 135; no reason beyond not feeling settled is invented.
